title: 四级方向 · 词汇搭配（自编）
subject: english
sourceNote: 同路自编练习，参考大学英语学习方向组织，非官方四级或六级真题，不承诺对应考试难度或分数。听力为合成朗读，非考试原音。答案与解析可离线查看。

questions.prompt: Please ___ your student card before entering the library.
questions.explanation: 进入图书馆前出示学生证，show 表示出示。grow 生长，lose 丢失，borrow 借入，与语境不符。

questions.prompt: The bus was late, so we had to ___ for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: 公交车晚点，因此等待二十分钟。wait for 后接等待的时长或对象；waste 是浪费，不与 for 这样搭配。

questions.prompt: You can ___ this book for two weeks before returning it.
questions.explanation: 借书后可保留两周，用 keep。take off 脱下或起飞，bring up 提起或养育，turn down 拒绝。

questions.prompt: The room is too dark. Could you turn ___ the light?
questions.explanation: 房间太暗，需开灯，用 turn on。turn off 是关灯，方向与语境相反。

questions.prompt: Mia is interested ___ learning a new language.
questions.explanation: 固定搭配 be interested in 表示对某事感兴趣，in 后可接动名词 learning。

questions.prompt: The train will ___ at the station at nine.
questions.explanation: arrive at 接小地点，如车站。reach 是及物动词，后不接 at；get 要搭配 to。

questions.prompt: We need to ___ a decision before Friday.
questions.explanation: make a decision 表示作出决定，属于动词与名词的固定搭配。do 不与 decision 搭配。

questions.prompt: This exercise looks difficult, but the teacher will ___ it clearly.
questions.explanation: 老师会清楚解释练习，用 explain。complain 抱怨，contain 包含，remain 保持。

questions.prompt: The two bags are similar, but mine is ___ heavier.
questions.explanation: slightly heavier 表示稍微重一点；slightly 可修饰比较级。其他选项不表达这里的程度关系。

questions.prompt: Students are encouraged to ___ in the discussion.
questions.explanation: take part in 表示参加活动或讨论。take place 是发生，take care 是小心。

questions.prompt: Please read the instructions ___ before using the machine.
questions.explanation: 修饰动词 read 需要副词 carefully，意为仔细地。careful 是形容词。

questions.prompt: The new timetable is ___ on the notice board.
questions.explanation: 课表可在公告栏上查到，用 available（可获取的）。comfortable 舒适的，afraid 害怕的。
